summary: RDR-079 and its LID artifacts are reconciled with origin/main, and the system-test workflow now bounds and retries PostgreSQL client installation.

references.result: RDR-079 records the provider-neutral work-item model, Linear-first integration, offline GitHub migration, separate pull-request artifacts, rollout guard, implementation phases, and validation scenarios.
The RDR index contains one Draft P1 entry for RDR-079.
The merged LID design references the canonical RDR-079 and preserves the proposed work-item boundaries.
passed: all arrow references, including unified-work-items, are valid; the report's uncovered-spec and staleness warnings are repository-wide existing planning gaps.
PostgreSQL client installation uses three five-minute-bounded retries with 30-second HTTP(S) acquisition timeouts and three acquisition retries.
